bullets.text: Chennai residents suffered long power outages on Sunday prompting the office to monitor TNPDCL actions.
A car suddenly caught fire on a road near Velachery causing panic while police investigate the accident.
Avadi residents faced difficulties on East Gopalapuram Road due to narrowed paths from Metro Water Board work.
Numerous devotees gathered with their families at the Tiruttani Murugan temple on Sunday holiday for worship.
Tamil Nadu is experiencing a new wave of global capability centre expansions and new setups.
India saw a resurgence in multi-city data centre investments during the first half of 2026.
Google is advancing its USD 15 billion AI data hub in Visakhapatnam despite community scrutiny.
Prime Minister Modi inaugurated Rs 13,000 crore projects including the Poonamallee-Vadapalani metro rail service.
Chief Minister Vijay requested Prime Minister Modi to reconsider metro rail projects for Madurai and Coimbatore.

stories.title: Day or night, Chennai city swelters through endless power cuts
takeaways: Residential neighbourhoods across Chennai faced prolonged power outages on Sunday despite being a holiday.
The Tamil Nadu Power Distribution Corporation Ltd must address these recurring distribution network failures.
